patch_description:
Replace the current-state KVPR greedy rule with a minimax rule that evaluates the KVPR after placing each model. The previous implementation selected the GPU with the smallest current pressure, which can place a large/high-rate model onto a GPU where its resulting KVPR is very high.

The revised placement tries several inexpensive ordering strategies, retains the feasible placement with the lowest maximum KVPR, and then applies improving single-model moves. Each candidate placement is evaluated using the actual objective: the maximum KVPR across all GPUs after the assignment. This directly aligns the heuristic with the optimization target while retaining strict memory-capacity checks.
